limitations: No registered account-export sources: inaccessible/deleted/unsynced history is unknown, not empty.
Later-created forks can contain prior May/June ancestry not inventoried here; sibling July/August coverage may recover them.
cv prompts contains task notifications and delegated briefs; rows are not certified human turn counts.
No exhaustive semantic reading of all 4506 distinct body texts; targeted selected bodies/excerpts and context only.
Metadata relevance and literal prompt matching can include related-but-extraneous projects and miss alias-free connections.
60 undated prompt rows preserved, not assumed outside scope.
No present-HEAD proof/build/deployment statuses certified by history recovery.
UTC date boundaries used; local New York midnight differs.

duplicate_policy.secondary_reading: exact text across timestamps grouped for navigation, not claimed separate occurrences all duplicate
